configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.displayName: CNA's default renderer for this platform
configurePresets.description: One renderer: OPENGLES3 on Linux, SDL_RENDERER on Windows/macOS. Needs ../cna, ../sharp-runtime (and ../easy-gl, ../meta-gl on Linux).

configurePresets.name: windowless
configurePresets.displayName: Windowless renderers (SOFTWARE default) - CI, no display needed
configurePresets.description: SOFTWARE;HEADLESS;STUB. Runs every demo without a display server and without the GL siblings.

configurePresets.name: linux-multi
configurePresets.displayName: Linux: GL, SDL_RENDERER and the windowless renderers in one binary

configurePresets.name: linux-full
configurePresets.displayName: Linux: every supported Linux renderer including SDL_GPU, plus the C API
configurePresets.description: Adds SDL_GPU (libshaderc) to linux-multi and builds CNA's experimental C API (CNA::CApi) for the c_api standalone demos.
